about: The 62 Community Planning Districts adopted by the NYC City Planning Commission on March 1, 1968, drawn from the boundary streets in its report "Community Planning Districts: Boundaries and Procedures for Modification" (March 1968, https://archive.org/details/communityplannin00newy_0) onto 2020 census blocks (DCP). Joint Interest Areas (parks, cemeteries and the like) belong to no district. text: the report's boundary description.
